Patched copy of librqbit-tracker-comms
======================================

Upstream: librqbit-tracker-comms 9.1.0 from crates.io (rqbit repo
crates/tracker_comms, commit 4309d38769ef93f6ee4f01a1ab147009a197fa8f; see
.cargo_vcs_info.json). Files are as published, except:

- src/tracker_comms_udp.rs, UdpTrackerClient::new: if binding the UDP
  tracker socket on [::]:0 fails, log a warning and retry on 0.0.0.0:0;
  error only if both binds fail.
- LICENSE and PATCH.txt added; the registry's .cargo-ok marker removed.

Why: upstream binds the UDP tracker socket on [::]:0 with no IPv4 fallback,
and librqbit's Session::new_with_opts always creates this client (even with
trackers disabled). On hosts without an IPv6 stack (kernels booted with
ipv6.disable=1, some containers and sandboxes) session creation fails with
"error creating UDP socket at [::]:0: Address family not supported by
protocol (os error 97)" (EAFNOSUPPORT), so no torrent can start.

Wired in by [patch.crates-io] in the workspace Cargo.toml; the directory is
excluded from the workspace, so our fmt/clippy gates do not apply to it.

Drop this patch when upstream falls back to IPv4.
